places.name: Cueva del Indio
places.ai_summary: Cueva del Indio features ancient petroglyphs and stunning ocean views, making it a must-visit archaeological and natural site.
places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for climbing rocks.
places.address: Cueva del Indio, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Arecibo Lighthouse & Historical Park
places.ai_summary: This park combines history and fun with a lighthouse, pirate-themed attractions, and panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for the scenic views.
places.address: Arecibo Lighthouse, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Cueva Ventana
places.ai_summary: Cueva Ventana is a large cave with a window-like opening that offers breathtaking views of the Río Grande de Arecibo valley.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the cave's history and geology.
places.address: Cueva Ventana, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Arecibo Observatory Site (Historic)
places.ai_summary: The Arecibo Observatory, once home to the world's largest radio telescope, is a key site for astronomical research and planetary radar observations.
places.place_tip: Check for special events or tours in advance.
places.address: Arecibo Observatory, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.ai_summary: This park is famous for its extensive cave system and the Río Camuy, offering unique geological formations and eco-tourism opportunities.
places.name_english: La Cueva del Río Camuy Park
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothes and shoes for walking and climbing.
places.address: La Cueva del Río Camuy Park, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.ai_summary: A beautiful beach known for its clear waters, coral reefs, and as a great spot for snorkeling and diving.
places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear and refreshments.

places.ai_summary: The town plaza of Arecibo is a central spot for socializing, events, and enjoying local cuisine at surrounding restaurants.
places.place_tip: Try the local street food and visit on weekends for events.
places.address: Arecibo Town Plaza, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.ai_summary: The Cueva Clara Tour offers an exciting adventure through a stunning cave with a river, waterfalls, and unique rock formations.
places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes if you plan to swim in the river.
places.address: Cueva Clara, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Río Abajo Forest Reserve
places.ai_summary: Arecibo's Río Abajo Forest Reserve is a protected area with lush vegetation, hiking trails, and opportunities to see native wildlife.
places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, and wear comfortable hiking shoes.
places.address: Río Abajo Forest Reserve, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Mirador Cueva Ventana View
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint near Cueva Ventana that offers one of the most iconic and photographed views in Puerto Rico.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the sunrise.
places.address: Mirador Cueva Ventana, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Arecibo Historical District
places.ai_summary: The historical district of Arecibo features colonial architecture, charming streets, and important cultural sites.
places.place_tip: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the architecture and history.
places.address: Arecibo Historical District, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.ai_summary: Cueva del Agua is a stunning sea cave known for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant marine life, accessible by boat or kayak.
places.place_tip: Bring a swimsuit and towel if you plan to swim.
places.address: Cueva del Agua, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.place_tip: Be cautious on the rocks and watch for slippery areas.

places.ai_summary: A hilltop viewpoint offering panoramic views of Arecibo, the Atlantic Ocean, and on clear days, the coast of the Dominican Republic.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for better views, and visit the old lighthouse ruins.
places.address: El Vigía Hill, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Arecibo Surf Point
places.ai_summary: A popular spot for surfing, known for its consistent waves and beautiful beach setting.
places.place_tip: Check surf reports before you go, and bring your own equipment.
places.address: Arecibo Surf Point, Arecibo, Puerto Rico

places.name: Local Seafood Restaurants
places.ai_summary: Arecibo offers a variety of seafood restaurants where you can enjoy fresh, local dishes with a view of the ocean.
places.place_tip: Try the mofongo and fresh ceviche.
